1.43 Download every Cloud Smart Preview through outages

Symptom. “Store all Smart Previews locally” leaves hundreds of thousands pending for days.

Method. The preview download controller asks Cloud’s ordinary getProxyPaths for each photo: 12 requests of 32 photos at a time. It backs off when a batch comes back as all CannotSync, retries transient refusals and never retries SendNoDownloadableOriginal.

Evidence. 87,257 previews downloaded in one overnight run on an 868,000-photo library. The 529 refused during a 45-minute outage all succeeded on retry.

Limits. Quitting Cloud ends the run. Originals are not downloaded.
